free.title: Inwood Hill Park
free.caption:
OUTDOORS · INWOOD HILL PARK

Manhattan has an actual forest, and most people who live here have never set foot in it.

Inwood Hill Park, at the island's northern tip, is the only spot left with woods that were never cleared - plus Manhattan's last natural salt marsh, glacial potholes carved into exposed bedrock, and a rock where the Lenape are said to have met the first Dutch settlers. Three marked trails loop through it, none longer than a couple miles, and the whole thing is free and open dawn to dusk.

Go west at the fork for river views, then grab lunch at Indian Road Cafe right by the park entrance.

Send this to the friend who thinks they've hiked everywhere in the city.

food.title: Arthur Avenue Retail Market
food.caption:
FOOD · ARTHUR AVENUE, THE BRONX

Everyone calls Mulberry Street 'Little Italy,' but the neighborhood locals actually shop in is up in the Bronx.

Arthur Avenue Retail Market has run since the Depression era - one roof, a dozen family-run stalls, zero Manhattan markup. Mike's Deli stacks a torpedo sandwich big enough for two, Peter's Meat Market has been cutting to order since the 1930s, and Bronx Beer Hall pours nothing but New York State beer in the back corner. Step outside and Arthur Avenue itself keeps going - bakeries and cafes on both sides of the block.

Come hungry - the sample trays alone could be lunch.

Send this to whoever still thinks Little Italy is only in Manhattan.

art.title: Balloon Museum Daydream
art.caption:
ART · DAYDREAM AT BALLOON MUSEUM

The world's first permanent inflatable art museum just opened at the Seaport, and it's nothing like the balloon animals at a kid's party.

Daydream fills the historic Tin Building with room after room of large-scale inflatable art from major names like Marina Abramovic - built to walk through and get lost in, not look at from behind a rope. It's Balloon Museum's first permanent home anywhere in the world, after years of touring pop-ups in other cities. Every room is built differently, so nothing repeats as you move through.

Book a timed slot online - walk-ups aren't guaranteed on weekends.

Send this to whoever needs an excuse to put the phone down and actually look up.
